cases.expected: Returns a non‑null JsonSchema instance whose meta‑schema matches the default meta‑schema and contains the supplied schema node.
cases.description: Typical usage: both JsonNode and SchemaValidatorsConfig are provided. The method should delegate to newJsonSchema and produce a valid JsonSchema object.

cases.expected: Throws NullPointerException (or IllegalArgumentException) because the schema JsonNode is required.
cases.description: Edge case where the schema node is null. The factory should reject a null JsonNode and raise an exception.

cases.expected: Returns a non‑null JsonSchema instance using the default SchemaValidatorsConfig.
cases.description: Config parameter is optional; when null the factory should fall back to its default configuration.

cases.expected: Throws NullPointerException (or IllegalArgumentException) because the schema JsonNode is required, regardless of config being null.
cases.description: Both parameters are null – the method must still reject the missing JsonNode and raise an exception.

cases.expected: Returns a non‑null JsonSchema whose meta‑schema corresponds to Draft‑04 (the $schema value) and whose SchemaValidatorsConfig has typeLoose set to true.
cases.description: Schema node explicitly declares Draft‑04 meta‑schema and a custom config enables type‑loose mode; the factory must honour both the $schema URI and the supplied configuration.

cases.expected: Returns a non‑null JsonSchema instance using the default meta‑schema (the factory’s default) even though the schema node is empty.
cases.description: An empty JSON object is a valid (though useless) schema; the method should still create a JsonSchema object rather than throwing.

cases.expected: Returns a non‑null JsonSchema instance (the factory does not validate the content of the JsonNode at creation time).
cases.description: The supplied JsonNode is a primitive numeric node, not an object schema. The factory should still wrap it in a JsonSchema; validation errors would surface later, not during creation.

cases.expected: Returns a non‑null JsonSchema whose internal SchemaValidatorsConfig has failFast set to true.
cases.description: A custom configuration that enables fail‑fast validation is supplied; the created JsonSchema must carry this configuration forward.

cases.expected: Throws IllegalArgumentException (or JsonSchemaException) because the $schema URI is syntactically invalid and cannot be normalized.
cases.description: The schema node contains a $schema property with a malformed URI. The factory should detect the invalid URI during meta‑schema resolution and raise an exception.

cases.expected: Throws IllegalArgumentException (or JsonSchemaException) because the $schema IRI does not correspond to any supported meta‑schema version.
cases.description: The $schema value points to an unknown/unsupported draft version. The factory should fail fast when it cannot locate a matching JsonMetaSchema.

cases.expected: Throws NullPointerException (or IllegalArgumentException) because the $schema field is present but its value is null.
cases.description: A schema node explicitly defines $schema with a null value. The factory should treat this as an invalid meta‑schema reference and raise an exception.

cases.expected: Throws IllegalArgumentException (or JsonSchemaException) because the $schema string is blank/whitespace only, which cannot be resolved to a meta‑schema.
cases.description: The $schema property is present but contains only whitespace. The factory should reject this as an invalid meta‑schema identifier.
